name: True Kult
review:
True Kult is a 5x3 cult-horror slot. Baptism By Fire stacks reveal a high-paying Devotee or a scatter. Two or more scatters immediately open reel 6 for 729 ways, and three start The Seance bonus.

Stacked True Believer symbols only land on reel 6. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 23,237x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
